observed_r4.interpretation: Dynamic Control is corroborating access to the same PhysX-backed state, not an independent sensor; borrowed tensor references are mutable and were excluded from certificates.
observed_r4.wrapper_copy_policy: R4 converts each returned value to a new float64 array before journaling

dynamic_control.behavior: deprecated articulation state wrapper used only in B/E as same-backend corroboration

simulation_step.behavior: step(render=False) calls PhysicsContext._step; render refreshes app and may update kinematic articulations only on CUDA

single_articulation_wrapper.behavior: delegates to ArticulationView and returns row zero

source_limitations: The R3 archive had no pointer/dtype metadata, so historical aliasing remains unknown.
Link transforms corroborate pose evolution but do not independently measure joint velocity.
The CPU SimulationContext selects MBP and disables GPU dynamics from its device branch; this runtime adaptation is recorded, while the frozen builder and authored scene identity remain unchanged.
unavailable_or_not_used_as_repair: No installed CPU API was found that turns a stale reported velocity into a certified independent measurement.
omni.physics.tensors.flush was not used as a repair; installed documentation marks it deprecated/no-op for this path.
update_articulations_kinematic was not used to rewrite physical state; it is a kinematic update path, not a velocity-source validator.
